# Kinograph

Kinograph is a martial arts skill tree for progressive physical practice. Nodes represent exercises that unlock as prerequisites are mastered — designed with ADHD in mind to remove decision fatigue and pacing fatigue.

## Features

- [Skill tree](/) — 252 nodes across striking, grappling, conditioning, and mobility
- [EMOM Timer](/timer.html) — configurable interval timer with deep-link support from skill nodes

## Source
